lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 3.3 million buildings with geometry in multiple formats (SHP, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, KML), representing an estimated 51% of total buildings in Hungary based on AI-mapped estimates.
